moltenIllumination.headingPour: Molten copy of each heading word, heat-ramp gradient clipped to text, revealed top-down by clip-path as the heading rises from 92% to ~55% of the viewport; holds mid-screen; cools back to display-ink as it passes the top. Scroll-linked. No drop-shadow (it paints a dark box on text-clipped gradients).
moltenIllumination.channel: 2px lilac→ember→molten-white line with ember underglow under the heading hairline; fills left to right with the pour and stays lit.
moltenIllumination.rail: 18rem right-edge rail (≥1280px): molten gradient fill with a 6s downward current, molten-bead head; 7px diamond section marks (radius 1px) ignite ember when the molten front reaches them and stay lit; current section's mark scales up.
moltenIllumination.reducedMotion: No pour, no current; headings plain; rail fill static.
moltenIllumination.exception: The only sanctioned gradient text in the system; always transient.

moltenLine.marking: data-snake=top|middle|bottom; data-snake-x=flush (default 10px short of the element); stops past 45% of the viewport are skipped
moltenLine.head: 62% of viewport height; draws down on scroll down, retracts on scroll up; reached stops ignite and clear
moltenLine.route: name (middle) → section heading channels (flush) → role titles → institutions → left-column project cards (all cards on phones) → skills grid → certification groups → contact card
moltenLine.stroke: 1.6px + 7px underglow at 14%, square caps, mitred corners, vertical heat gradient reflecting every 1600px
moltenLine.layer: z-index -1 after the shader canvas: over the field, behind content and panels
moltenLine.reducedMotion: drawn in full, all stops lit
moltenLine.geometry: straight/orthogonal: vertical trunk 18px left of the leftmost stop; a horizontal branch out to each stop and back
moltenLine.experienceRail: retired; the trunk is the timeline

narrative.overview:
The page is a studio portal. A single full-screen WebGL field, silk ribbons of fine strands running lilac into ember over a deep void, is the ground of everything; the work floats over it as thin, condensed, uppercase display type, small tracked labels, plain sentence-case body, and a few solid ink panels edged in 1px mist hairlines. The identity is carried by the moving surface and the huge condensed type, with very little else on screen. This world replaced an earlier periodic-table world that the owner rejected as cluttered, so restraint is the operating principle: sleek and clean beats dense and decorated.

Density is low and the rhythm is generous: sections are separated by a fluid 6 to 11rem band, content sits in a 1480px measure, and the left of the field is kept near-void so type always reads on quiet ground. Interaction is where the richness lives: the field leans toward a hovered project's hue, project cards tilt and their architecture diagrams flow faster, skill groups illuminate while the rest dim, credentials flip to their certificate and open into a full-screen sheet through a circular clip-path, arrows page through that sheet, and the whole page scrolls with inertia. Every one of these is kept by the owner's instruction, and every one has a calm fallback.

Confirmed rejections: no glass blur, no glow halos, no monospace, no gradients on text, and nothing from the previous site's look (JetBrains Mono, blueprint console, cyan). No headline numbers anywhere: figures live inside sentences, tinted, never enlarged.

### Project page family
The four GitHub Pages project sites (Experiment Decision Engine, ReelRank, Fieldnote, Casefile) are the same system in long-form: void ground, the same ribbon field, Archivo condensed display in display-ink, tracked labels, lilac as the accent, ember only on hover, and the same diagram vocabulary with mint and soft red as outcome tones. Their look lives in two master files, `/Volumes/Crucial_1TB/projects/project-sites/_theme/theme.css` (tokens and components) and `/Volumes/Crucial_1TB/projects/project-sites/_theme/field.js` (the shader, with no hover lean, its quiet mask moved further right, and a calmer scroll falloff), copied into each site folder. Edit the masters and recopy; a change to this file's tokens should be mirrored there.
keyCharacteristics: One living shader field as the ground of the whole page; panels float over it, never replace it.
Archivo variable at condensed width (wdth 64), light weight (350), uppercase, for every display line.
Small uppercase labels tracked wide (0.16 to 0.34em) as the second voice; body stays plain sentence case.
Lilac is the voice of the system; ember appears in the interface only when something is hovered, pressed, current, or focused, with the Resume outline as the one exception.
Solid ink panels with 1px mist hairlines; depth is offset shadow on hover only.
Motion everywhere, all of it dropped or frozen under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember in the interface marks a state, never a resting surface: hover, pressed, current, focus. At rest, chrome is mist, dusk, starlight or lilac. Project families carry two colours: a resting marker that is never ember (lilac for analytics, mist for AI engineering) and an accent (lilac or ember) used only on hover and active states. The shader's ribbons and the per-project flow-line fallback drawings are world materials and keep their family hue. The single sanctioned resting-ember element is the Resume outline (header pill and hero action), because the resume is the primary exit; it sets no pattern for any other button.

rules.name: The Tinted Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every figure in running text is set in lilac-text at weight 650 with tabular numerals, in place, at the size of its sentence. A number is never promoted to its own line, its own size, or its own card.

rules.name: The True Photo Rule
rules.body: A real photograph is dimmed and washed into the palette before it is placed; it never outshines the display type.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px mist line (line for dividers inside content, line-strong for the edges of panels, tiles and pills). No filled dividers, no thick rules.

rules.name: The Condensed Display Rule
rules.body: Display lines are Archivo at wdth 64, weight 350, uppercase, letter-spacing -0.01em, line-height 0.88 to 0.9. Never bold, never at normal width, never with a gradient fill.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Uppercase belongs to display lines and tracked labels. Body copy and summaries stay sentence case at normal tracking.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. Lift appears only as a response to hover or focus, and it is black, never tinted.

rules.name: The Solid Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels are ink at 86% or solid void. No backdrop-filter, no frosted glass, no coloured halo behind a surface.

dos: Do keep the shader field as the ground of every surface, with the left of the viewport near-void behind type.
Do set display lines in Archivo at wdth 64, weight 350, uppercase, line-height 0.88 to 0.9, revealed by a masked rise (y 110% to 0, 1s, ease-out, 0.07s word stagger).
Do run every figure in a sentence through the inline-numeral treatment: lilac-text, weight 650, tabular, at the sentence's size.
Do keep ember for hover, pressed, current and focus in chrome and type; at rest use mist, dusk, starlight or lilac.
Do float content on ink at 86% with a 1px line-strong edge, and reach for Lift only on hover or focus.
Do design the unlit state: dim to 32% and keep it readable rather than hiding it.
Do grade real photographs into the palette (dimmed, slightly desaturated, under a lilac-to-void multiply wash) so the display type leads the fold.
Do keep a project card to its diagram, name, a one or two sentence summary, and two actions (GitHub, Website).
Do mark in-progress items with a dashed 1px lilac-text pill, and pair every colour signal with text or shape.
Do use the shared easing (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) at 200ms for colour and border changes and 480ms for layout, opacity and shadow.
Do give every motion a calm path: under reduced motion or still mode, the field freezes, diagram edges stop, inertial scroll is skipped, entrances are dropped and the sheet fades in 0.15s.
donts: Don't feature a big headline number for any project, role or credential; numbers stay inside sentences, tinted, never enlarged.
Don't put ember on a resting button, border, label or icon; the Resume outline is the one exception, and family markers at rest are lilac or mist.
Don't use outcome mint or outcome red outside a diagram node.
Don't use backdrop blur, frosted glass, glow halos or coloured shadows.
Don't use a monospace face, or the previous site's blueprint console look and cyan accent.
Don't fill text with a gradient.
Don't add a busy grid of tiles, a grid background, or more panels than the content needs; the identity is the field and the type, not containers.
Don't set body copy in uppercase or tracked wide; that voice belongs to labels.
